name: pubsub
description: A lightweight topic-based Publish-Subscribe (PubSub) message bus. Supports wildcard topic matching (*, **), synchronous and asynchronous delivery, message history replay for late subscribers, one-time subscribers, and unsubscription.
aiPromptContext: Use this block to decouple components using events across modules, implement cross-component communication in frontend apps, or build lightweight service bus messaging without external dependencies.
